title: Metric-Independent Expansiveness
summary: In this article we introduce and study a natural form of expansivity, that we call \textit{metric-independent expansiveness}, for group actions on metrizable spaces. This notion means \textit{expansive with respect to every compatible metric}. For actions on locally compact $σ$-compact metric spaces, we show that this property admits a purely topological characterization: it is equivalent to what we call \textit{cocompact expansivity} and to the existence of an expansive extension to the one-point compactification.
